data.name: Ketu
data.gender_notes: Ketu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Ketu is a shadow planet that represents spiritual growth, transformation, and self-realization through trials and tribulations. The name Ketu carries the meaning “Shadow planet” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ketu usually hope their child will grow to embody shadow planet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the search for enlightenment and the understanding of the deeper truths of life.
data.etymology: Ketu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shadow planet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ketu total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: Ketu is an important celestial body in Hindu astrology, often associated with spirituality, spiritual trials, and spiritual growth. It is depicted as a headless snake, or simply as a horse's head, representing the severe challenges and hardships one may face in life that can ultimately lead to spiritual advancement.
data.spiritual_significance: According to Hindu spiritual beliefs, Ketu represents the true north node or the ascending node of the Moon, which is believed to be the place of spiritual growth and evolution. It is believed that when Ketu influences a birth chart, the individual may face challenges and hardships that test their character and strength, ultimately leading them towards spiritual growth and self-realization. Additionally, Ketu is believed to grant the blessings of the South Node, Rahu, which represents material desires and worldly pleasures, helping the individual find a balance between spiritual growth and material success.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ketu symbolizes spiritual secrets and hidden knowledge. As the South Node of the Moon, it represents past life karmic debts and lessons to be learned through its shadow, Rahu. In astrology, Ketu's influence fosters detachment, spiritual growth, and transformation.
